question.text: Consider two ideal diatomic gases <math><mi>A</mi></math> and <math><mi>B</mi></math> at some temperature <math><mi>T</mi></math> . Molecules of the gas <math><mi>A</mi></math> are rigid, and have a mass <math><mi>m</mi></math> . Molecules of the gas <math><mi>B</mi></math> have an additional vibrational mode and have a mass <math><mfrac><mrow><mi>m</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></mfrac></math> . solution.text:
